Iron Vow ballistic audio

The rifle, rotary, and rail reports use "AR15 rifle shot" by michorvath.
https://freesound.org/people/michorvath/sounds/427596/

The shotgun and cannon reports use "20 gauge shotgun gunshot" by michorvath.
https://freesound.org/people/michorvath/sounds/427595/

Plate and shield contacts use "Metal Radiator Hit Bang Impact 96kHz.flac" by qubodup.
https://freesound.org/people/qubodup/sounds/50674/

All three recordings are CC0. The Iron Vow cues use edited excerpts and
original synthesized layers. The edit recipe is tools/render_ballistic_audio.py.

Iron Vow machinery audio

"Servo motor" by Burningmonkey (leg servo)
https://freesound.org/people/Burningmonkey/sounds/322021/
"Robotic Arm.aiff" by 4ntony (weapon brace)
https://freesound.org/people/4ntony/sounds/204801/
"Battle Mech walks (fast & slow sequence)" by Breviceps (left and right footfalls)
https://freesound.org/people/Breviceps/sounds/557594/
"Big robot footstep 004" by AudioPapkin (heavy footfall)
https://freesound.org/people/AudioPapkin/sounds/813055/
"Pressure Hiss" by unfa (vent)
https://freesound.org/people/unfa/sounds/211096/
"Scary Machine Startup.wav" by TraceyRegina (power-up)
https://freesound.org/people/TraceyRegina/sounds/647225/
"Air vent (looped)" by lfyaudio (idle)
https://freesound.org/people/lfyaudio/sounds/848969/

These recordings are CC0. The edited cues can be rebuilt with
tools/render_machinery_audio.py using the corresponding Freesound previews.
